title: Transform lists with map, keep and combine
objective: Use map to change every item, keep where to choose items, and combine to fold a list into one value.

body.text: Map, keep and combine each take a list and a rule, and run the rule on the items. map using builds a new list with the result for each item. keep where keeps only the items that pass a test. combine with start folds the whole list into one value, starting from the value you give.

body.title: Double every number
body.code:
function double
    takes number called x
    returns a number
    gives back x times 2

make numbers equal to a list of 1, 2, 3
make doubled equal to map numbers using double
repeat for each n in doubled
    say "{n}"

body.text: A rule can also be written in the line itself, with taking and giving back. keep where tests each item with it. combine with start 0 using taking start and value adds up the list: start holds the running total, and value is the next item.

body.title: Keep and add up
body.code:
make numbers equal to a list of 1, 2, 3, 4
make big equal to keep numbers where it is greater than 2
say "{size of big}"
make total equal to combine numbers with start 0 using taking start and value giving back start plus value
say "{total}"

body.prompt: The filter keeps nothing because the cut-off is too high. It should keep only the numbers greater than 2, so the program prints 2.
body.starter:
make numbers equal to a list of 1, 2, 3, 4
make big equal to keep numbers where it is greater than 9
say "{size of big}"
body.solution:
make numbers equal to a list of 1, 2, 3, 4
make big equal to keep numbers where it is greater than 2
say "{size of big}"

body.prompt: The fold totals 11, but 1 plus 2 plus 3 plus 4 is 10. Make it print 10.
body.starter:
make numbers equal to a list of 1, 2, 3, 4
make total equal to combine numbers with start 1 using taking start and value giving back start plus value
say "{total}"
body.solution:
make numbers equal to a list of 1, 2, 3, 4
make total equal to combine numbers with start 0 using taking start and value giving back start plus value
say "{total}"
